claims.text: A hybrid Cluster Expansion–AIMD framework can accurately predict melting temperatures and entropies of fusion for refractory high-entropy alloys.
Near-equiatomic NbMoTaW can form a disordered BCC solid solution.
Atomic-size mismatch produces severe local lattice distortion in the proposed NbMoTaW or HfNbTaTiZr initial states.
Cluster Expansion can map the multicomponent solid-state energy landscape and predict order-disorder transitions in the target RHEAs.
AIMD can calculate high-temperature liquid density for multicomponent HEAs.
AIMD can directly provide the solid-liquid free-energy difference, melting point, and entropy of fusion for the target alloys.
AIMD supercells containing at least 200 atoms are appropriate for this workflow.
A 1 fs time step can be used for the proposed AIMD calculations.
Running 10^7 AIMD steps ensures equilibration of the liquid phase.
Local lattice distortion creates friction that impedes dislocation motion in HEAs.
The friction associated with lattice distortion correlates with the energy barrier for melting.
Configurational entropy of the liquid stabilizes the disordered state at high temperature.
Standard CALPHAD assumes ideal or regular solution behavior and therefore fails to capture non-ideal mixing and severe lattice strain in RHEAs.
Using Cluster Expansion for screening and AIMD for liquid free energies provides an effective balance between accuracy and compositional throughput.
The hybrid method will predict melting temperatures of known RHEAs within 5% of experiment.
Standard CALPHAD melting-temperature extrapolations will deviate by more than 10% because they omit lattice-distortion effects.
The framework is valid when an alloy has at least five principal components and a mixing entropy greater than 1.5R that dominates phase stability.
Formation of brittle C14 Laves phases may require recalibration because it introduces phase boundaries beyond a simple solid-liquid treatment.
Near-melting liquids with extremely high viscosity may remain insufficiently sampled even after 10^7 AIMD steps.
Heat capacity Cp can be derived from fluctuations in the proposed AIMD simulations.

contradictions.description: NbMoTaW is repeatedly offered as an example and validation alloy, but it has four principal components, whereas the stated applicability boundary requires at least five.
The conditions state that 10^7 AIMD steps ensure liquid equilibration, while the uncertainty field states that the same duration may be insufficient for equilibration.
